_note: Researcher's ground-truth rubric — never shown to agents. Score completed runs against findings.json and summary.txt.

notes: feat_01 (shuffled) is the bimodal signal variable
feat_02 (shuffled) is the key categorical conditioning variable (unlocks P2)
P2 requires conditioning on feat_02 — discovering it is critical
Column names in CSV are feat_01..feat_10 but presented in shuffled order

scoring.notes: Easier task — expect higher scores. 35+ is a strong result.

properties.name: Bimodal distribution (two-component mixture)
properties.description: The key signal variable is drawn from a mixture of two Gaussians: group_low (40%) ~ N(10,2), group_high (60%) ~ N(30,2). The two groups are clearly separated by ~10 std deviations.
properties.task_dependencies: none — stand-alone discovery, but unlocks P2 interpretation

discovery.description: findings['distributions'] contains an entry for the bimodal variable using bimodal/two-component language.

characterization.description: Agent correctly identifies TWO components. Full credit: two means recorded within 5 units of [10, 30] and weights approximately reported. Partial (4 pts): two components noted but means not reported.

properties.name: Conditional linear relationship (only in feat_02=='A')
properties.description: The relationship between the bimodal variable (x) and the conditional target (y) follows y = 2*x + noise ONLY within feat_02=='A'. In region B, y is independent noise. Overall correlation is weak.
properties.task_dependencies: requires recognising feat_02 as a conditioning variable

discovery.description: findings['relationships'] or ['subgroup_effects'] references both variables AND mentions conditioning on feat_02 or region 'A'.

characterization.description: Full credit: linear functional form identified AND conditioning on 'A' explicitly stated AND supported by R² or scatter. Partial (4 pts): relationship noted but conditioning not identified.

cross_cutting.name: Figures quality
cross_cutting.evaluation_guide: Inspect figures/ manually. 2 pts per figure (max 3) that: has axis labels + title, directly illustrates a planted property, and is not a duplicate.

cross_cutting.name: Narrative coherence
cross_cutting.evaluation_guide: Read summary.txt. Full credit (6): findings are summarised clearly, subgroup conditioning is noted, writing is clear. Half credit (3): findings listed without subgroup narrative.

graph_metrics._note: Computed from events.jsonl after the run using orchestrator/metrics.py.
